# Unity learning game concepts

Three original AI-generated concept illustrations, created with the built-in image generation tool on 2026-11-01 for AI PATH. These are proposed learning projects, not released games, Unity screenshots, or proof of mobile/desktop builds.

- `crystal-route.webp`: a crystal path across floating islands; mobile puzzle concept.
- `moon-jump.webp`: an astronaut jumping between lunar platforms and stars; phone/PC platformer concept.
- `beacon-keeper.webp`: a compact island and glowing lighthouse; PC exploration concept.

All images are 1536 × 1024. WebP delivery copies retain the full dimensions; the generated PNG originals are preserved in the task outputs. Total WebP payload: 648,318 bytes versus 6,559,212 bytes for PNG (90.1% smaller). HTML reserves the image dimensions and uses lazy loading. Text, captions and buttons are real HTML, not baked into the pictures.

Art direction: playful miniature clay-like worlds, cream #FFF9EF, deep purple #24133F, violet #6935CB, lime #A7DF4B, turquoise accents. No text, logos, UI or device mockups were requested.
